title: The First Time is Free
description: The First Time is Free — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: The Wishing Well

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: The first time you use the Wishing Well it is free. Good luck!

Quest Reward: None listed in the client files

Return to: The Wishing Well

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: The first time you use the Wishing Well it is free. Good luck!

Offer:

This is your first time? Well, you are in luck because the first time if free!

Turn-in:

You concentrate hard and make a wish. You hear a sound emanating from the well!

Objectives:

  • King's Coin ×1

Client level range: 1–100
